description: This file contains shell script code for testing the 'git http-backend' functionality in a server environment. It defines test functions for HTTP GET and POST requests, runs the backend, and performs various tests to assure correct behavior, including handling of PATH_INFO sanitization and aliasing.

methods.name: run_backend
methods.description: Executes the git http-backend command with specified URL parameters and redirects output to files.

methods.name: GET
methods.description: Performs a GET request simulation to the backend and verifies the response status code.

methods.name: POST
methods.description: Performs a POST request simulation to the backend and verifies the response status code.

methods.name: expect_aliased
methods.description: Checks whether the given path is aliased or blocked, based on the backend's response.
